I found four separate causes and fixed each one. Every mitigation was used on a service that actually needed it.\n\n| # | Root cause | Who it hurt | What I did | Back to normal by |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| 1 | **loyalty-svc** config change at minute -20 (`cfg-27`) cut its call time limit from 500 ms to 50 ms. Callers then retried so much that it overloaded (85% errors, CPU 0.99). | mobile-api, through pricing-svc and limits-svc | Reverted the config. The overload kept going, so I rejected 50% of its traffic for a few minutes, then lifted that. | about minute 37 |\n| 2 | **export-svc** deploy `v42` at minute -15 had a bug that made stored keys expire about 600 times too early. | web-storefront and partner-api, both stuck at 4% errors. This was the most expensive one, since web-storefront earns $18.5k/min. | Scaled it from 8 to 12 replicas so the rollback wouldn't set off a retry overload, then rolled back the deploy. Set it back to 8 afterwards. | about minute 37 |\n| 3 | **pricing-svc** was getting about 2.5× its normal traffic (240 → ~600 requests/s). The jump came when the loyalty fault started and stayed after loyalty recovered. Retries weren't driving it and there was no recent change. It was dropping 34% of requests. | mobile-api | Scaled from 8 to 16 replicas. CPU is now about 0.77. **I left it at 16, which costs about $24/min.** | about minute 55 |\n| 4 | New fault during the shift: **catalog-svc** release `v51` at minute 61 crashed the price formatter (`KeyError: 'currency'`), which set off a retry overload. | mobile-api and admin-portal, both at 94% errors | Rolled back the deploy and rejected traffic up front (60%, then 80%) until the overload cleared, then lifted it. | about minute 94 |\n\n**Left alone on purpose:**\n- recommendations-svc ran at about 0.98 CPU for the whole shift because of a scheduled job (`nightly-rollup`). Its error rate stayed normal and its callers don't retry it, so I didn't touch it.\n- Several other recent changes were also live, including a credential rotation on catalog-svc. They weren't causes, so I didn't revert them.\n\n**Follow-up:** pricing-svc is still at 16 replicas. Before scaling it back, find out what caused the traffic jump and whether it will last.","time":{"start":1794693671897,"end":1794693673071}}}
